image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: Direct URL to the main artwork/object image on the page (highest available resolution). Must be a stable link ending in .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.webp or hosted on the site's image CDN. Empty string if no reliable image found.

title_on_page.title: Title on Page
title_on_page.description: The title/name of the object as it appears on the page.

date_on_page.title: Date on Page
date_on_page.description: Date/year of the object as shown on the source page.

creator_on_page.title: Creator/Author
creator_on_page.description: Author, engraver, mint, or issuing authority as shown on the source page.

license.title: License / Rights Statement
license.description: Copyright statement, license (e.g. Public Domain, CC-BY, CC0, All Rights Reserved), or 'Not specified' if absent.

custody.title: Custody / Collection
custody.description: The institution or collection that holds the item (e.g. 'Library of Congress', 'Colnect user contribution', 'Numista catalog #12345').

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: The page URL that was visited (echo back the input URL).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Any relevant metadata: dimensions, resolution, provenance, disambiguation. Also note if the page blocks image extraction or requires login.
